name: Chipotle Burrito Bowl
desc: Copycat Chipotle bowl with cilantro lime rice, chicken, corn salsa, and guac

ingredients.raw: Marinade: 1/4 red onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp adobo sauce, 1 tbsp ancho chile powder, 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp oregano
Rice: 1 cup basmati, 1 bay leaf, cilantro, lemon and lime juice
Corn salsa: 12 oz corn, 1/4 cup red onion, 1 poblano, 1 jalapeno, cilantro, citrus juice
Tomato salsa: 1 lb tomatoes, onion, cilantro, jalapenos, lime
Guac: 2 avocados, lemon, lime, onion, jalapeno, cilantro
Black beans, cheddar cheese for assembly

steps: Blend marinade ingredients. Marinate chicken at least 30 min or overnight.
Cook chicken in oiled skillet to 165°F. Chop into pieces.
Boil rice with bay leaf and salt 10-12 min. Drain, rinse, stir in cilantro and citrus juices.
Make corn salsa: cook corn, toss with onion, peppers, cilantro, and citrus.
Make tomato salsa and guacamole by combining their respective ingredients.
Assemble bowls: rice, chicken, beans, salsas, guac, and cheese.
